properties.name: Hunyadiváros
properties.method: Manual Figure74 source-stroke guides trace original maxRGB<=45 JPEG pixels. Three explicitly enumerated blue-text-overprint intervals use low-confidence bounded manual continuations with unselected alternative paths; thirteen vertices are not strict source-black observations. No source-frame closure, buffer, repair, geographic snap or simplification is used. A photo-only Figure73-to-Figure74 affine uses thirteen fitted and ten held-out texture patches, with all twenty-five rejected searches and preliminary attempts retained. Its inverse is composed with the archived Figure73 metric EOV affine, independently refitted from its six original manual image observations and literal OSM road coordinates. The new footprint extends beyond the observed photo overlap and the original calibration image. Source-text overprints and full geographic placement remain explicit inferences; photographic residuals are not absolute boundary accuracy.
properties.sourcePeriod: 2021 May municipal consultation draft; underlying orthophoto capture date unknown.
properties.license: Municipal source-map reuse rights unverified; ODbL-1.0 for OSM geographical controls and name point.
properties.sourceScopeNote: The separately labeled Hunyadiváros proper source cell. PDF155 expressly distinguishes it from Ceglédi út, the southern economic source cell and the station-side development cell; the larger Hunyadiváros–Ceglédi út umbrella is not cloned under the fine name.
properties.sourceFactoryScopeCaution: The source prose assigns the 1928 poultry factory to Hunyadiváros. The map divider appears to place its northwestern factory footprint on the Ceglédi-labelled side. Preserve this map/prose scope nuance and the exact pictured Hunyadiváros contour; do not move the contour or substitute the separate southern economic triangle.

sourceRaster.coordinateConvention: Integer original-image pixel centers, x right/y down, no extra half-pixel offset.

sourceBoundaryInference.reason: Three short economic-divider intervals are overprinted by the blue source label. Manual continuations and unselected alternatives are explicit.

reviewNotes: Thirteen source vertices across three short blue-text-overprint intervals are manual source-boundary inferences. All other vertices are original maxRGB<=45 black source pixels. No full black-contour claim is made.

The final source cell is preserved separately from the umbrella and the distinct southern economic/station-side cells. The factory map/prose scope nuance is retained without changing the pictured source boundary.
Only common photographic overlap is tested; most of the source contour extends beyond it. The inherited Figure73 geographical calibration remains inferred.
Current exact/legal extent, original photo date, open source-map reuse rights and address assignment remain unverified.
